description: Validate load-guidance source and actual-versus-target contract (REQ-036; AC-R036-01, AC-R036-02, AC-R036-03; G24, R04, R31; #663). Engineering definition with a typed read model (src/state/refinement-load-guidance.ts: prescribedLoad, performedLoad, LOAD_MEANINGS, LOAD_GUIDANCE_SOURCES, LOAD_DEFINITION_DEPENDENCIES) over the existing owners loadText, equipmentName, reviewLoadSuggestions and History's loggedSet/movementActualReadings, adopted by liveMovementReadings, and the contract docs/specs/LOAD_GUIDANCE_CONTRACT.md. check-01 proves: every load meaning and unit comes from the prescription's own columns through loadText with no range and no guessed unit; no per-hand rewrite or gloss of the stored number; prescribed target and performed weight stay apart, each in its own unit; every source owner exists and no synthetic preview range is promoted; TASK-003's AC-R003-04 receipts (check-01, check-02) are current and passing and the Review weight change is removed for the circuit only; the LOAD-RANGE-RULE and LOAD-PER-HAND definition dependencies are recorded with owner Eric; and the accepted gallery state /gallery/refinements?state=cards (reference eded158cfd928d382c9a9409e2c372270312741d) draws every load as the read model's target. Every declared case must execute and pass.

check-01.command: node scripts/refinement/run-required-check.mjs --task TASK-036 --check check-01 -- npx vitest run src/state/refinement-load-guidance.test.ts --passWithNoTests=false
